source.manualTitle: Samsung NE58F9710WS Flex Duo Electric Range (FER710DRS)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Disconnect electrical power at breaker before servicing. Replace all panels before operating. 240 VAC present at terminal block when energized.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing the range. Replace all panels before operating range.

steps.title: Door plunger switch
steps.body: Check plunger switch normal-close state. Inspect wire, housing, and terminals for damage.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Check plunger switch normal-close state. Inspect wire, housing, and terminals for damage.

steps.title: Replace door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace or repair door plunger switch or harness.
